rationale: Price is sitting just 0.26% above today's low ($1062.79) after a large intraday reversal from $1106 high, with the last trading near $1065.54 — well below VWAP ($1080.31) and the 9-EMA ($1067.20), indicating sustained selling pressure despite the strong earnings beat.
